$comment: 10 real operator questions mined from last week's cortex-ide work (issues #960-971, PRs #944-980, commits c7940062..a27bf484). 3 are answerable from CLAUDE.md/DESIGN.md alone (docs-favored); 7 require PR-body or composer.ts source comments (PR/commit-favored). Each has a reference answer for the judge to score against. The judge applies a 3-axis rubric (factual_accuracy / citation_correctness / specificity, 0-1 each).

cases.question: What's the data directory override environment variable for cortex-ide, and what's the default path?
cases.referenceAnswer: The override variable is CORTEX_IDE_DATA_DIR. Default path is ~/.cortex-ide.

cases.question: What is the minimum touch target size enforced in the o8 design system, and what's the rationale?
cases.referenceAnswer: 44px minimum for all interactive elements, per Apple Human Interface Guidelines.

cases.question: How is a new o8 release shipped from a developer's machine? What is the exact local command sequence?
cases.referenceAnswer: npm version patch (bumps + tags via sync-version.mjs hook), then git push --follow-tags, then npm run ship (cargo tauri build with signing key + uploads via scripts/release.mjs to GitHub releases). Auto-update banner in installed app picks it up.

cases.question: Why was the OpenRouter Class A composer timeout in eval mode bumped from 10s to 25s? Be specific about the regression that prompted the change.
cases.referenceAnswer: Ownership category accuracy crashed from 35% to 2% in eval mode because composer Class A's OpenRouter call timed out at 10s on the full 30-row payload (after the rows.slice(0,20)→(0,30) fix). p95 for multi-row prompts was past 10s. 25s gives headroom for worst case without hanging real failures too long. Same bump applied in the classifier.

cases.question: Which composer model is the eval-mode tier 0 primary, and what's the approximate per-run cost?
cases.referenceAnswer: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 via OpenRouter (model id 'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6'). Approximately $0.026 per smoke run. Picked because false-negative cost on the ship gate exceeds the bill.

cases.question: Why is the Sonnet CLI timeout set to 300s in the composer Class B path?
cases.referenceAnswer: Sonnet CLI bootstrap can take 60-90s, then multi-row synthesis adds another 30-60s on the 30-row composer payload. The prior 60s default killed the call before the model even started generating, forcing fall-through to paid OpenRouter even when the user has a free Claude Max subscription. 300s lets the free CLI tier actually deliver.
groundTruthSources: src/lib/cortex/qa/composer.ts: callSonnet timeoutMs comment in composeClassB

cases.question: What does the daily compactor cron job do? What categories of work does it perform on the facts table?
cases.referenceAnswer: The compactor performs four jobs: (1) GC orphans (facts whose source rows are gone), (2) dedupe near-duplicate facts, (3) time-decay scoring of older facts, (4) near-dup merge into canonical facts. Runs daily via cron, scheduled per #915.
groundTruthSources: commit c38e4d93 'feat(qa): fact compactor — GC orphans, dedup, time-decay, near-dup merge (#915)'

cases.question: What does the fs.watch on docs feature do, and which issue introduced it?
cases.referenceAnswer: fs.watch on docs (CLAUDE.md, README.md, AGENTS.md, etc.) triggers incremental re-distillation when the founder edits these files, so the Brain stays in sync without a full re-index. Introduced in issue #964, shipped as PR #976.
groundTruthSources: github issue #964 'fs.watch on docs — incremental re-distill'

cases.question: What was the ownership-category regression that prompted the rows.slice(0,20) → rows.slice(0,30) fix in src/lib/cortex/qa/composer.ts?
cases.referenceAnswer: Project rows from emitProjectRows landed at retrieval ranks 21-24 and got truncated by the slice(0,20). The retriever's unionMerge has MERGE_LIMIT=30, so the slice in the composer was tighter than the merge ceiling. Result: ownership accuracy stayed at 35% even after PR #949 paid the bill of adding project + project_repo retrieval. Matching the slice to MERGE_LIMIT=30 unlocked the project rows for the composer.

cases.question: What is the source_authority value the composer assigns to a merged PR versus an open PR, and which row type has the highest authority?
cases.referenceAnswer: Merged PRs are 0.95, open PRs are 0.8. Directives are the highest at 1.0. Outcomes are 0.9. Closed issues are 0.85, open issues are 0.75. Comment opinions are 0.7. Fact rows pre-v18 backfill default to 0.5.
